The following events took place in '''4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 31''' after the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
[[File:LandoTheYoung.jpg|thumb|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] gained ownership of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].]]

*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] acquires the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> awaken [[Arden Lyn]] from a<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> 24,496-year long<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> period in stasis.<ref name="EGW" />
*Lando Calrissian discovered the [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]]; its accidental activation caused massive changes in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]].<ref name="TEGASxi">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], p. XI</ref>
*The [[Service Special]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] was developed.{{Circa}}<ref name="LC: FoO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
*[[Slyder]] moved onboard the ''[[Star of Empire]]''.<ref name="DF:SFTE" />
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was captured by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] but was quickly rescued by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
*[[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] attempted to [[Death/Legends|slaughter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo's]] [[Tetsu Clan|family]], forcing them to flee to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
*[[Vengler]] was discovered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. {{Circa}}
*The [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]] was destroyed by the [[Bonestar Pirates|Bonestar Pirate]] [[Loka Hask]] in his attempt to evade capture by the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="TPA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair]]''</ref><ref name="GusTreta">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places this event when [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was 17 years old. He was born in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to {{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}.</ref>

==Births==
*[[Irek Ismaren]]<ref name="Irek's Age">In Chapter 18 of [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], Leia states that Irek "had to have been at least four years old" when Leia first encountered Roganda before the Battle of Yavin. This was referenced in ''[[The Emperor's Pawns]]'', which states that Irek was eight years old at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. However, this reference was ignored by later sources, such as ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' and the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'' which sets Irek's age at 14 in ''Children of the Jedi'', which would place his birthdate as [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. For the purposes of this article, the original 4 BBY date is used.</ref>
*[[Ederlathh Pallopides/Legends|Ederlathh Pallopides]]<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
